allianz-uk-booklet.finding: Section: Territorial limits and European cover, printed p.11. Ireland excluded from foreign-day limit.

saga.finding: Section I, printed pp.27–28. Standard 90; Select 180; Plus unlimited per policy year, permitted destinations.

lv.title: LV= — Driving abroad FAQs

admiral.title: Admiral — Driving in Europe

aviva-uk.finding: Foreign Use is optional on Aviva Signature comprehensive; 90 days per trip and 180 days per year when included, specific product exclusions.

aviva-ie.title: Aviva Ireland — Car insurance FAQs

aviva-ie.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

allianz-ie.title: Allianz Ireland — Coverage and benefits FAQs
allianz-ie.finding: Same policy cover across continental Europe up to 60 days per insurance period.
allianz-ie.reviewType: Direct publicly accessible HTML page reviewed against published statement

allianz-ie-wording.title: Allianz Ireland — Motor policy wording
allianz-ie-wording.finding: Irish territorial limits and legal minimum in Europe; automatic extension 60 days per insurance period.
allianz-ie-wording.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

123ie.title: 123.ie — Driving abroad customer care
123ie.finding: EU minimum legal cover automatically; full Irish cover for up to 30 days requires arrangement before travel.
123ie.reviewType: Direct publicly accessible HTML page reviewed against published statement

axa-ie.title: AXA Ireland — Green Card to UK
axa-ie.finding: Ireland-registered vehicles can use insurance disc as proof in UK, including Northern Ireland.
axa-ie.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

progressive.title: Progressive — International car insurance
progressive.finding: Progressive US policies apply in Canada; separate Mexican liability; limited exception in parts of Texas.

progressive-road.title: Progressive — Car insurance for road trips
progressive-road.finding: US coverage generally applies in Canada; a separate policy is needed for Mexico.

usaa.title: USAA — Auto insurance FAQs
usaa.finding: Canada liability meets legal requirements for own car; Mexico requires Mexican issued liability; Canadian rental coverage differs.

geico.title: GEICO — Driving in Canada and Mexico (March 2026)

icbc.title: ICBC — Driving outside British Columbia
icbc.finding: Autoplan coverage extends across Canada and US for vacation driving.

icbc-booklet.finding: Basic insurance fine print printed p.4. Basic cover is Canada/US only, not Mexico.
icbc-booklet.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

racv.title: RACV — Motor insurance current PDS (July 2026)
racv.finding: General exclusions printed p.24: loss or damage outside Australia; exclusions apply across policy types.

racv.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

ami.title: AMI — Car policy wording (November 2024)
ami.finding: Incidents outside New Zealand exclusion, printed p.32.
ami.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

aviva-uk-product-lines.title: Car insurance product tiers and Foreign Use included as standard

aviva-uk-product-lines.reviewType: Previously documented source; not revalidated in this release

axa-uk.title: AXA UK — Types of car insurance cover / international territories
axa-uk.finding: AXA describes the same cover as selected in the UK for up to 90 days per policy year in listed European countries. Its European-driving guide excludes courtesy-car cover abroad. Verify the individual issued policy schedule.
axa-uk.reviewType: Official insurer website text inspected against published annual allowance and territorial country list; not a customer schedule

axa-uk-docs.title: AXA UK — AXA / AXA Plus policy documents and issued-policy caveat
axa-uk-docs.finding: The website provides sample policy wordings for AXA and AXA Plus. AXA states that the wording that actually applies to a customer is available during quotation and in the customer account after purchase.
axa-uk-docs.reviewType: Official policy-document catalog inspected; sample wording is not a customer-issued schedule

direct-line.title: Comprehensive Plus automatic foreign use
direct-line.finding: Comprehensive Plus includes automatic comprehensive foreign-use cover for up to 90 days abroad; policy terms apply.
direct-line.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

direct-line-pdf.title: Direct Line motor policy booklet, where you can drive
direct-line-pdf.finding: Booklet page 35: Comp+ European foreign-use extension up to 90 days per insured period; the Republic of Ireland is within the home territorial benefit.
direct-line-pdf.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

churchill.title: Comprehensive Plus car insurance
churchill.finding: Churchill describes automatic comprehensive foreign-use cover for up to 90 days; confirm the policy edition and destination.
churchill.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification
churchill.documentEdition: Website product page (no booklet edition supplied)

tesco.title: Driving in Europe
tesco.finding: Bronze, Silver and Gold give the same cover level as at home for 90 days in a policy year. Republic of Ireland has a separate 90-consecutive-day rule.
tesco.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

tesco-faq.title: Car insurance FAQs
tesco-faq.finding: Only permanent UK-resident named drivers qualify for 90-day EU cover; other-car driving benefit is not valid abroad.
tesco-faq.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

esure.title: European car insurance guidance
esure.finding: Published European same-as-home level cover up to 90 days; day-counting basis is not explicit in this overview.
esure.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

allstate-ca.title: Does my U.S. car insurance work in Canada?
allstate-ca.finding: Most U.S. car insurance policies may follow a driver to Canada for short trips, but a specific Allstate contract and optional coverages need confirmation.
allstate-ca.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

allstate-mx.title: Mexico auto insurance for tourists
allstate-mx.finding: Allstate says domestic policies are unlikely to cover Mexico and Mexican-issued insurance is needed; Allstate facilitates tourist products.
allstate-mx.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

statefarm-mx.title: Driving to Mexico
statefarm-mx.finding: State Farm advises Mexican-issued liability for drives beyond border-area exceptions. This does not verify any issued State Farm personal policy.
statefarm-mx.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

statefarm-rental.title: Rental car insurance abroad
statefarm-rental.finding: State Farm says Canada can be an exception to typical overseas rental exclusions; users must verify their actual domestic policy.
statefarm-rental.reviewType: Insurer primary publication inspected for this research release; not individual policy verification

release: v7.0.0: evidence-first comparison with tier-country facts, real insurer source links and policy-year guardrails

changeLog.description: Added Direct Line Comp+, Churchill Comp+, Tesco Bronze/Silver/Gold, esure Europe, Allstate Canada/Mexico and State Farm Mexico sources. No insurer term change date is claimed without an earlier comparable edition.
Separated Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland; added explicit Ireland exceptions for Direct Line, Churchill and Tesco; added unknown status for insufficiently sourced providers.
Added vehicle-type guardrails, detailed per-country cells and per-cell evidence status. Previously published results retain their original review dates.
